title: AOD-Lint: Executable Verification for the Axiomatic Fundamentalism Protocol
description:

Boundary premises determine interior claims; undeclared imports are exterior flux.

AOD-Lint extends the Axiomatic Fundamentalism (AF) protocol from a human editorial guideline to a decidable verification calculus over finite typed manuscript graphs, accompanied by a self-hosted native Rust AST compiler and linter for Typst (.typ) and LaTeX (.tex) treatises.

  • main.pdf — The protocol extension: Epistemic boundary closure axioms, typed derivation DAGs, two-pass premise hoisting with ontological liability receipts, the 8-bit Reviewer Rubric Boolean meet-semilattice 𝔹8, finite AFC Stokes and trit-capacity verification, one-way Main/Manual quotient firewalls with SHA-256 immutability, bounded-hop blast-radius slicing, and source-tree epistemic hygiene.
  • manual.pdf — Reference engine and worked ledgers: Rust crate architecture (src/), CLI execution spine (check, digest, slice, hygiene), worked 9-column Declared Edge Computation (D.E.C.) and discrete Stokes fixtures, repository state-leakage quarantine rules, and the Stratified Axiomatic Inquiry multi-agent protocol.
